generate_expression_and_result: generate a modular arithmetic expression with brackets and its computed result given a modulus and length
generate_raw_dataset: generate a dataset of modular arithmetic expressions with brackets and their integer results for training
create_task_modular_arithmetic_brackets: create a ModularArithmeticBrackets task instance with a configurable modulus and optional multiplication operator
sample_batch_task: sample a batch of one-hot encoded input expressions and output results from the modular arithmetic task
get_input_output_sizes: get the input and output vocabulary sizes for the modular arithmetic brackets task
